landing.tagline: For excursion and boat trip operators
landing.title: Receptionists sell your trips. You only pay commission.
landing.intro: Build your own affiliate network: hotels, guesthouses and guides who recommend your trips to tourists, with links, QR codes and commissions worked out automatically.

qr.title: A QR code for every affiliate
qr.text: The receptionist shows the code, the tourist scans it and books on their own. Every sale goes to whoever recommended it.

fast.title: Booking in 30 seconds
fast.text: The affiliate books straight from their phone, and the customer pays by scanning a code or from the link they get on WhatsApp.

commission.title: Fixed or progressive commissions
commission.text: You set the percentage, or levels that grow with sales. Affiliates see their earnings in real time.

tickets.title: Tickets with a QR code at boarding
tickets.text: The tourist gets the ticket on their phone; at boarding you scan it with the camera, no extra apps needed.

steps.products: You add your trips, prices and departures.
steps.invite: You invite receptionists, concierges and guides as affiliates.
steps.recommend: They recommend with the QR code or book for the tourist.
steps.pay: The tourist pays online; the commission works itself out.
